page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing speeds, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, fall into the bottom 25% tier, and single-threaded gzip compression performs in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core execution scales effectively, achieving average tier results in stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth, both cached and uncached, consistently registers in the middle 50% range.

The instance demonstrates average performance for database operations, Redis SET transactions, and static web serving. While it is not suited for single-threaded tasks or heavy local storage requirements, its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio offer reliable resource density for multi-threaded applications. This makes the ecs.sn2.3xlarge appropriate for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, multi-threaded data processing, and moderate database hosting.
